visualCharacteristics: Light grey band (#f5f5f8), centered. Bold lead-in line then three dark rounded tiles (hours / minutes / seconds) ticking down.
contentPattern:
Interactive time-based component that cannot be authored statically. Represented with the existing project 'widget' block whose single cell links to a countdown widget (e.g. /widgets/countdown.html?end=<ISO end datetime>); the digits are rendered by the widget, never authored as headings. The deal end time is not exposed in page data and must be supplied by the author.

Countdown widget: three dark rounded digit tiles with hours/minutes/seconds labels.

User decision: the deal end date is not available on the source page; use a placeholder end date that authors can edit (e.g. a widget URL like /widgets/countdown.html?end=<ISO datetime>).
usage: Live hours/minutes/seconds countdown to an authored end date (e.g. deal ends in).
reuseGuidance: Author the end date as plain text in ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59+08:00 (placeholder; edit per campaign). Optional key/value rows: "End | <datetime>", "Labels | hours, minutes, seconds". Do NOT author a /widgets/... link: scripts.js auto-blocks /widgets/ links into the generic widget block. Put the lead-in text as default content above the block. Shows 00 tiles and adds class "expired" after the end date, "no-end-date" if none parses.
